name.full: AI Scrum Master — daily stand-up bot and manager dashboard

description.short: Runs your daily stand-up and surfaces a live manager dashboard.
description.full: Posts a daily stand-up prompt, collects each member's done/next/blockers update, and reports back a summary. Managers get a read-only dashboard tab showing today's status and stand-up history.

commands.title: scrum-setup
commands.description: Configure stand-up time, timezone, and team for this group

commands.title: add-member
commands.description: Add a member to this team's stand-up roster
